payload.title: Keep partial check success separate from explicit task completion
payload.description: The frozen 0.3.11 model experiment observed a passing normalization-only check marking the whole jobs requirement verified while scheduling remained unfinished. Record current check evidence without closing work; require explicit implemented finish and prevent finish while structured plan steps remain outstanding. Legacy statuses are not silently migrated.
acceptance: A passing stage check leaves backlog/in-progress intent open with current evidence and retained ownership.
Explicit task_finish implemented runs configured checks, records verified completion and releases ownership only after success.
Outstanding structured plan steps reject an implemented finish before semantic mutation; progress completion alone does not finish work.
Meaningful CLI/MCP and dependency regression checks pass; historical benchmark remains frozen on 0.3.11.
